headline: Wall Street Bought Net $4 Billion in Bitcoin Funds During Q3, Galaxy Research Says
summary: Institutional investors purchased a net $4 billion of Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending three consecutive quarters of selling, though selling pressure resumed this quarter.
why: Flows into US Bitcoin exchange-traded funds and funds represent the primary vehicle for institutional crypto allocation, directly affecting spot cryptocurrency market liquidity.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Wall Street funds bought $4 billion net in Q3 before renewed selling returned this quarter.
